excluded_development_pilot.reason: used only to debug the adapter before freezing; excluded from the final three-seed comparison

autonomous_arms.base: base-SHA ordinary symbolicRegression on ComplexRegressionProblem; complex interpreted, real-valued constants; Pareto loss/complexity
autonomous_arms.candidate: same seeded search; complexSymbolicRegression fits real and imaginary coefficient coordinates for best and Pareto-front topologies using training data only
autonomous_arms.diagnostic: supplied generic topology with unit real starting coefficients, fit on training rows only; reported separately

grammar.initializer: ordinary unconstrained initializer; no target topology or target constants seeded

symmetry_equivalence: count canonical affine addition/multiplication operand swaps and Cos(b*z)=Cos(-b*z) as one topology class
failed_runs: report one record per task/seed including timeout, missing search model, fit failure, or other failure
